title: The Grunion Run, one lantern
logline: Thirty years since the first. One lantern on the beach, Gully's, and the fish come anyway, and the pup, twelve, walks the surf line instead of running it. The lamp from 2011 beside the lantern, lit this time.

panels.composition: The beach at night: one lantern on a stake, and beside it, on the sand, a green swing-arm lamp — lit, from an extension cord that runs off the page. The surf line silver with fish. An old three-legged dog walking it slowly. Two men from behind, sitting on the sand, one heavy, one thin.

image.notes: The 2011 lamp (dw_2011-06-03, dw_2020-03-13), lit at last. The cord off the page.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run

notes: One lantern and the lamp, lit. Thirty years.
